children: Coinbase, the U.S. cryptocurrency exchange, has launched prediction market products tied to short-term price moves in Bitcoin, Ether and Solana.
On October 25, Coinbase wrote on X, formerly Twitter, that “crypto price prediction markets are now live on Coinbase in real time.”
Users can trade by predicting price moves in BTC, ETH and SOL, with contract durations ranging from 15 minutes to one day.

title: Coinbase Launches BTC, ETH, SOL Short-Term Price Prediction Markets With 15-Minute to Daily Contracts
